tool_args.rationale: The narrow pilot does not identify how the law behaves away from s_grad near 1 or discriminate reliably among the recalled concave mechanisms. The open-branch probe is the least-cost available discriminating measurement.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the Haldane or Cobb-Douglas model to the pilot
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five observations vary mainly u_now, leaving the gradient dependence and competing concave mechanisms poorly identified.
The immediate ambiguity is across input regimes rather than trajectory resolution; this probe also costs more.
It is not relevant to distinguishing the candidate mechanisms.
